# 7-Zip Extra 26.05

Unmodified x64 `7za.exe` from Igor Pavlov's official 7-Zip Extra release, used as a separate process for ZIP/7z plugin imports. It is not loaded into Forge. Users may replace this standalone executable with a compatible build.

- Official download page: https://www.7-zip.org/download.html
- Binary archive: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.05/7z2605-extra.7z
- Binary archive SHA-256: `f27a8f103c84785026edcba1f67faf1357225df9d19ddb0b7760d55947141bc7`
- Included `7za.exe` SHA-256: `7ddf0a3bc451e166679296be630d6f0573eb386159c04184761c43020c484291`
- Corresponding source: included `7z2605-src.tar.xz`, also https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.05/7z2605-src.tar.xz
- Source SHA-256: `0b6080b8c3e7a579161d2d495224c0e51c467576cb4c7048b0ab485ef44cc22e`
